2607.27240.title: Asymmetric Collapse in Model Merging: When Refusal Over- writes Recognition
2607.27240.paper_summary: Model merging is often used to combine capabilities from separately fine-tuned models without additional training, but it is unclear whether standard merging methods preserve multiple safety-relevant behaviors simultaneously. We study this question through a controlled case study using two Gemma-3-1B-IT finetunes on two complementary safety objectives: CARES harm-level classification and WildJailbreak adversarial refusal. We merge the two fine-tunes using Linear, SLERP, TIES, and DARE-TIES, and evaluate the merged models on classification accuracy, attack resistance, and benign compliance. Across all four methods, attack resistance transfers significantly more than classification accuracy: merged models retain 81-85% jailbreak refusal rates while CARES accuracy falls to at most 12.9%. Weight-space measurements suggest that this asymmetry is not caused by strongly opposing task-vector directions: the two task vectors are nearly orthogonal (cosine similarity 0.011). Instead, the refusal fine-tune induces consistently larger per-layer task-vector magnitudes, causing magnitude-sensitive methods to favor refusal updates. These results show that standard model merging can collapse safety recognition into broad refusal when safety-relevant task vectors differ substantially in scale.
2607.27240.paper_summary_zh: 模型合併通常用於在不進行額外訓練的情況下，結合來自單獨微調模型的能力，但尚不清楚標準合併方法是否能同時保留多種與安全相關的行為。我們通過一個控制案例研究來研究這個問題，使用兩個 Gemma-3-1B-IT 的微調，針對兩個互補的安全目標：CARES 傷害級別分類和 WildJailbreak 對抗拒絕。我們使用線性、SLERP、TIES 和 DARE-TIES 合併這兩個微調，並在分類準確性、攻擊抵抗力和良性遵從性上評估合併模型。在所有四種方法中，攻擊抵抗力的轉移顯著高於分類準確性：合併模型保持 81-85% 的越獄拒絕率，而 CARES 的準確性最多降至 12.9%。權重空間測量表明，這種不對稱並不是由於任務向量方向強烈對立所造成的：這兩個任務向量幾乎是正交的（餘弦相似度 0.011）。相反，拒絕微調導致每層任務向量的大小一致較大，這使得對大小敏感的方法更傾向於拒絕更新。這些結果顯示，標準模型合併在安全相關的任務向量在規模上有顯著差異時，可能會將安全識別壓縮為廣泛的拒絕。
